name: io.github.bithug01/greenpick
title: GreenPick
description: Design-time sustainability co-pilot: greener, cheaper cloud infrastructure decisions with carbon + cost + latency tradeoffs, in-editor.

environmentVariables.name: GREENPICK_CARBON_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Carbon data source: 'auto' (US->EIA, EU->ENTSO-E, else mock), 'mock', 'eia', or 'entsoe'. Defaults to mock (offline, no keys).

environmentVariables.name: EIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free US EIA-930 grid data API key (optional; enables live US carbon).

environmentVariables.name: ENTSOE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free EU ENTSO-E grid data token (optional; enables live EU carbon + day-ahead forecast).
